description: Sandstone-Hosted Uranium Potential of Alberta: Study of Oil and Gas Well Logs (tabular data, tab delimited format) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. This dataset evaluates the sandstone-hosted uranium potential of Alberta. An Alberta Geological Survey database of oil and gas well logs were queried to identify wells with gamma values greater than 300 API (American Petroleum Institute units). Coverage: Government of Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Its tags are 72E, 72L, 72M, 73D, 73E. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, XLS, XML. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
